prohibited.reason: The schema package is the persistent data contract and the root of the dependency graph.
Fixtures are pure data. Every package may devDepend on them, so any outgoing edge would create a cycle.
Commands are document transforms. UI and AI share one command bus that must work without a renderer.
Player and Producer share the runtime build. Shared code moves down into runtime, never sideways.
